4 · The address lattice. Each theorem sits at the seven ray values its page plots from its receipt, taken mod 9: a point of (ℤ/9)⁷. This cluster's centre is (1, 8, 7, 8, 1, 7, 5). Its nearest clusters, ranked by lift — pairs observed among each theorem's seven nearest points, over the pairs expected by chance from the two clusters' sizes: generated.lean (4 observed, 1.15 expected, lift 3.47), coin.lean (3 observed, 1.06 expected, lift 2.82), recovered.lean (3 observed, 1.33 expected, lift 2.25). A receipt is a hash, so nearness on this lattice is a property of the addresses, not of the mathematics; the mathematical binding is (1) and (2). Chance, measured: over 200 reshufflings of which cluster each point belongs to (seeded, so every rebuild gives the same numbers), a best lift at least this high arose in 47.0% of them — consistent with chance.

The theorems.

  1. universal_reflection_involution — (List.range 11).all (fun d => refl (refl d) == d) ∧ ((List.range 10).filter (fun d => refl d == d)).length = 1 record
  2. universal_centre_is_five — ((List.range 10).filter (fun d => refl d == d)) = [5] record
  3. universal_pairs_sum_to_ten — (List.range 11).all (fun d => d + refl d == 10) record
  4. universal_reflection_reverses_the_domain — (List.range 11).map refl = (List.range 11).reverse record
  5. universal_reflection_is_not_an_involution_above_ten — ((List.range 10).map (fun k => k + 11)).all (fun d => ¬ (refl (refl d) == d)) record
  6. universal_z9_reflection_permutes_the_units — ([1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8].map (fun d => (9 - d) % 9)) = [8, 7, 5, 4, 2, 1] record
  7. universal_millennium_reflection_escapes_the_units — ¬ ([1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8].all (fun u => [1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8].contains (refl u))) record
  8. universal_reflection_is_the_vortex_reflection_shifted — (List.range 10).all (fun d => (10 - d) % 9 == ((9 - d) % 9 + 1) % 9) record
